gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent High Grade Glioma; Anaplastic Astrocytoma; Anaplastic Oligodendroglioma; Glioblastoma; Gliosarcoma
Pathologically proven diagnosis of high grade (aka grade III or IV) glioma (anaplastic astrocytoma, anaplastic oligodendroglioma, glioblastoma, gliosarcoma)

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] PCI 24781 (other names: Abexinostat): Participants will take PCI-24781/Abexinostat on days 1 - 4, 8 - 11, and 15 - 18 of each 28-day cycle.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Recurrent High Grade Glioma; Anaplastic Astrocytoma; Anaplastic Oligodendroglioma; Glioblastoma; Gliosarcoma
Prior radiation therapy and standard temozolomide; additional therapies for previous progressions are eligible (prior bevacizumab and Optune are allowed)

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: characterize the pharmacokinetics (PK) of PCI-24781/Abexinostat, temozolomide, and the combination of the 2 drugs

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Changes in Acetylation of Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cell Histones, H3 and H4, During Treatment: Peripheral blood samples collected at baseline and during treatment will be analyzed for changes in acetylation of peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) histones H3 and H4.

role_evidence.quote: A Study of Temodar With Abexinostat (PCI-24781) for Patients With Recurrent Glioma
[EXPERIMENTAL] Single arm: Participants will receive a combination of PCI-24781/Abexinostat and temozolomide
A Phase I Study of Metronomic Temozolomide With Abexinostat (PCI-24781) for Patients With Recurrent High Grade Glioma
Participants will additionally initiate metronomic temozolomide on Cycle 1, Day 1 at a dose of 50 mg/m2, taken by mouth twice daily

coder_notes: Temozolomide is in a metronomic (non-standard) schedule as the named partner, coded established_therapy_experiment per rule 6; it could alternatively be read as soc_backbone, which would not change abexinostat being the only investigational agent. PK sample type not stated, so tumour_pk_planned unclear. Histone acetylation is measured in PBMC/exosomes (not tumour) so not listed as a tumour biomarker row; it is the basis for target_engagement_planned yes.
